children.name: Text
children.text: Four additive curtains (green, teal, magenta-violet, lime) are drawn as thousands of thin vertical rays. Slow noise moves their lower edges, so they fold and drift. Other noise fades each curtain in and out and makes the rays flicker. A soft bloom sits over the top, and the horizon glow rises and falls with the aurora's brightness.

children.name: Text
children.text: It has a deep gradient, a faint Milky Way band, and twinkling stars in three tints. About 26 brighter stars have a small cross flare, and a shooting star crosses every 11 to 27 seconds.

children.name: Text
children.text: Three ridges stand in front of each other. The nearest has pine silhouettes and frames the sides, leaving the centre open. The lake mirrors the whole sky and ridgeline in thin strips, each shifted sideways by gentle waves that grow toward the viewer. Drifting glints, a horizon glow, a vignette and a faint grain finish it.
